numerical_scope: Current three-scene ablations with paired seeds and scenario-specific protocols; previous forward campaign retained separately.
excluded: Environments, caches, generated outputs, legacy launchers, tuning logs, duplicate baseline configs/data, and implementations not used by the release entry points.

verification.training_smoke: 3 PEAS scenes + 9 ablation scene/variant pairs, 2 optimizer steps each; three MCvD 1-epoch tests; Frozen-PINN all three scenes smoke; Julia all three scenes 1-point/4-repeat smoke
verification.clean_distribution: Dependency-pruned release; environments, caches and generated outputs excluded. Training/figure checks run outside the distribution.

documentation.local_links_and_anchors_checked: Rechecked current local Markdown file links; existing layout/anchor structure retained.
documentation.feature_formula_checks: 80 position/time pairs per scene; all 5/10/11 feature columns match implementation to 1e-12

verification.updated_canonical_training_smoke: no_features and no_steady: 2 Adam steps, validation selection and selected checkpoint checked
verification.ablation_pdf_visual_check: Both current and previous versions regenerated from release archives
verification.updated_canonical_forward_training_smoke: Validation source and test source: 2 steps; selected checkpoint and validation aggregation tested
